court: Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

issues.label: Veterans Court jurisdiction
issues.why: Court must confirm it has statutory jurisdiction over the Board decision and the issues presented.

issues.label: Finality of Board decision
issues.why: Court must determine what portions of the Board decision are final and reviewable.

issues.label: Scope of appeal raised
issues.why: Court must identify whether the appeal challenges only reasons-or-bases error, failure to adjudicate a theory, or effective-date matters.

issues.label: Mootness after PACT grant
issues.why: Court must decide whether the Board’s PACT-based grant eliminates any live controversy.

issues.label: Case-or-controversy injury
issues.why: Court must decide whether loss of a potential earlier effective date is a cognizable, ongoing injury.

issues.label: Redressability by the Court
issues.why: Court must determine whether ordering Board adjudication of direct service connection could lead to earlier benefits and thus redress harm.

issues.label: Downstream effective-date doctrine
issues.why: Court must decide whether effective date is a separate downstream issue that bars current review here.

issues.label: Distinguish theory vs benefit
issues.why: Court must decide whether direct service connection is a distinct “benefit” claim or merely a theory for the same benefit.

issues.label: Duty to address raised theories
issues.why: Court must decide whether the Board must adjudicate all reasonably raised theories of entitlement.

issues.label: Robinson reasonably raised standard
issues.why: Court must apply the standard for when evidence/argument reasonably raises a theory the Board must discuss.

issues.label: Board reasons-or-bases adequacy
issues.why: Court must determine if the Board’s failure to address direct service connection violates 38 U.S.C. § 7104(d)(1).

issues.label: Implicit denial doctrine
issues.why: Court must assess whether the Board implicitly denied direct service connection or left it unadjudicated.

issues.label: Board’s authority to “inform RO”
issues.why: Court must decide whether the Board can delegate consideration of direct nexus evidence to the RO when deciding service connection.

issues.label: Proper remedy if error
issues.why: Court must decide whether to vacate/remand for adjudication, reverse, or dismiss based on the identified error.

issues.label: Harmless error analysis
issues.why: Court must determine whether any failure to address direct service connection could have affected the outcome (e.g., effective date).

issues.label: Direct service connection elements
issues.why: If merits are reached, court must consider current disability, in-service event, and nexus evidence for hypertension.

issues.label: In-service onset evidence
issues.why: Court must evaluate evidence suggesting hypertension began during 2004–2005 deployment (flight surgeon letter, records).

issues.label: Continuity/chronic disease rules
issues.why: Court must consider whether hypertension qualifies for chronic-disease presumptions/continuity under 38 C.F.R. § 3.309(a) and § 3.303(b).

issues.label: One-year presumption applicability
issues.why: Court must consider whether hypertension manifested to a compensable degree within one year of active service separation(s).

issues.label: Multiple active-duty periods
issues.why: Court must determine how two active-duty periods affect incurrence and presumptive periods.

issues.label: National Guard duty status
issues.why: Court must distinguish ACDUTRA/INACDUTRA from active duty for service connection and presumptions.

issues.label: Line-of-duty requirement
issues.why: For Guard periods, court must consider whether any disease was incurred/aggravated in line of duty during qualifying service.

issues.label: Aggravation theory
issues.why: Court must consider whether service aggravated preexisting hypertension and whether that theory was raised.

issues.label: Secondary service connection
issues.why: Court must consider whether hypertension is secondary to other service-connected conditions if reasonably raised by the record.

issues.label: Stress as causation theory
issues.why: Court must consider whether the asserted service-related stress theory requires medical nexus evidence and whether VA satisfied development duties.

issues.label: Duty to assist—medical exam
issues.why: Court must consider whether VA had to obtain a medical opinion on direct nexus given the submitted evidence.

issues.label: Duty to assist—records
issues.why: Court must consider whether VA obtained all relevant service and medical records for onset/nexus/effective date.

issues.label: PACT Act presumption scope
issues.why: Court must confirm Vietnam service qualifies and that hypertension is a covered condition under amended 38 U.S.C. § 1116.

issues.label: PACT Act effective-date limits
issues.why: Court must apply 38 U.S.C. § 5110(g) and 38 C.F.R. § 3.114(a) limiting retroactive awards under liberalizing laws.

issues.label: Direct vs PACT effective date
issues.why: Court must decide whether a direct-service-connection grant could yield an effective date earlier than Aug. 10, 2022 despite the PACT Act.

issues.label: Pending-claim effective date rules
issues.why: Court must consider whether the 2011 claim remained pending for direct service connection and what effective-date rule would apply if granted.

issues.label: Claim stream characterization
issues.why: Court must determine whether the 2011 filing encompassed direct and presumptive theories for the same hypertension claim.

issues.label: Effect of Board grant on claim
issues.why: Court must decide whether granting on one theory extinguishes the need to adjudicate another theory within the same claim stream.

issues.label: Prohibition on advisory opinions
issues.why: Court must ensure it is not issuing an advisory ruling about an effective date not yet assigned.

issues.label: Ripeness of effective-date dispute
issues.why: Court must decide whether the absence of an RO effective-date decision makes the controversy unripe.

issues.label: Collateral estoppel concerns
issues.why: Court must consider whether dismissal/merits rulings would improperly constrain future effective-date litigation.

issues.label: Precedential impact concern
issues.why: Court must consider whether its reasoning affects VA obligations to adjudicate theories in other PACT Act cases (institutional practice).

issues.label: Standard of review
issues.why: Court must apply correct standards (de novo for legal questions; clearly erroneous for fact findings; reasons-or-bases review).

issues.label: Relief requested scope
issues.why: Court must determine whether appellant seeks vacatur/remand for adjudication of direct service connection versus immediate effective-date assignment.

issues.label: Timing delays relevance
issues.why: Court must consider whether extensive adjudicatory delay bears on equitable concerns, but also whether equitable relief is within the court’s power.

issues.label: Equitable tolling/relief limits
issues.why: Court must consider whether any equitable doctrines could affect effective date or remedies and whether the court can grant them.

issues.label: Compliance with appeal procedures
issues.why: Court must confirm the appeal and reconsideration motion were timely and properly preserved issues for review.

issues.label: Adequacy of hearing consideration
issues.why: Court must consider whether Board properly considered hearing testimony and post-hearing evidence as raising direct service connection.
